name: 케네스
motion_summary: Eternal Return Kenneth Fiery Demolition: white hair, red scarf, black-red armour, pale face and stern red eyes per character reference, wielding massive black-red axe. R choreography MUST be uppercut axe slash, TWO spinning airborne cuts, then a heavy downward landing slam. Frames: ready; crouch grasp axe; uppercut slash with orange flame crescent; jump upward; first airborne horizontal spinning cut; body rotates; second airborne cut; axe overhead; plunge; axe slams ground and orange fire shock erupts below face; recover crouch; ready. Airborne frames 4-9 one based, floor origin fixed, keep whole axe and flames inside individual cell. Show actual pose rotation; NOT stationary burning aura.
visual_review: 도끼 올려베기, 도약, 두 회전, 낙하 분쇄의 실루엣 변화가 명확합니다. 붉은 눈과 스카프가 유지됩니다.
